text:
maya.finance: Heads-up — received invoice QRL-4823 from QuantumRails. It references PO `45021` (Infra - EU) but the invoice lines are billed to GL `SW-ENG`. Also shows a 5% early-pay discount applied even though PO 45021 has no discount terms. Attaching PDF.
procurement-bot: PO lookup -> `45021` = infra-eu, approver = sara.approvals, cost center = CCTR-330. Detected GL/PO mismatch. Suggested action: vendor confirm intended PO or issue credit/reissue invoice.
leo.procure: @vendor-quantumrails can you confirm which PO you intended? looks like 45022 is the SW engineering PO.
vendor-quantumrails: Sorry — our AR team applied the early-pay discount per our master svc agreement. They also pulled the wrong PO number when generating the invoice. We intended to bill vs PO `45022` (SW Eng). We can either reissue the invoice or issue a credit note.
sara.approvals: If vendor can reissue lean towards that. If they provide credit note referencing QRL-4823, we can accept and rematch. If they want us to accept the discount, need contract clause. @alan.finance_ops any concerns?
alan.finance_ops: Prefer vendor reissue or credit note. If we accept discount, need signed clause and GL reclass to SW-ENG (CCTR-210). Also note audit trail — prefer vendor-side fix.
leo.procure: Sounds good. Vendor, please reissue with PO `45022` and remove the discount, or send a credit note referencing `QRL-4823` and we'll process. I'll stop routing until resolved.
vendor-quantumrails: Understood — we'll send a credit note referencing QRL-4823 today and reissue the invoice with PO 45022. Apologies for the mix-up.
maya.finance: :thumbsup: I will put the invoice on hold in AP (status: on_hold) and create a ticket so we don't auto-pay. Ticket created: AP-9921.
procurement-bot: Ticket created: AP-9921 | reason: PO/GL mismatch + vendor discount | status: on_hold | owner: maya.finance
sara.approvals: Ping me once credit note arrives. If vendor provides credit and reissue, I'll approve routing. If they only ask for an exception, need legal sign-off.
maya.finance: Logged for audit: reason=vendor used wrong PO + early-pay discount applied; action=await credit note or reissued invoice; ticket=AP-9921. Will update thread when vendor sends docs.
